scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w payrent-backend" "npm run dev -w payrent-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w payrent-backend && npm run build -w payrent-frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start -w payrent-backend" "npm run start -w payrent-frontend"
scripts.postinstall: npm run db:generate -w payrent-backend && npm run copy-prisma-client -w payrent-backend && npm run db:generate -w payrent-frontend
